data.prompt: Locked-off 2D painted underwater cavern shot, exactly preserve the reference composition, architecture, arched road, colors, lighting direction and small character pose. Animate the ivory baleen fringes hanging from the ceiling and the distant hanging fringe as delicate flexible filaments immersed in seawater. Their attachment points remain absolutely stationary. A gentle irregular lateral current produces small traveling bends progressing down each filament: upper sections barely move, middle sections bend softly, tips lag behind then slowly settle with damped rebound. Neighboring filaments and separate clusters respond with subtly different phases and amplitudes, retaining their lengths, fine tapered silhouettes and strand separation. Motion is continuous, slow, fluid and clearly visible at the tips, never rigid pendulum rotation or synchronized blanket waving. Gentle water resistance and buoyancy; avoid snapping or whipping. Keep rock ceiling, walls, road, foreground, lamp, character and framing stable. No camera pan, zoom, cuts, global image warping, melting geometry, extra appendages, merging strands, stretching roots or exposure flicker. The animation focus is the natural underwater movement of the baleen.
